newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL AIM TO CLINCH CROWN AGAINST ATLETICO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL AIM TO CLINCH CROWN AGAINST ATLETICO.

text.p: Real Madrid president Lorenzo Sanz has warned that his side plan to seal their 27th league title in the derby with outgoing champions Atletico Madrid in two weeks' time.
"Gil, take a valium because we're going to celebrate the title with you," Sanz told his outspoken counterpart Jesus Gil on Monday.
Real need only one point from their final two matches of the season to clinch the championship they last won in 1995.
The league takes a rest next weekend because of Spain's World Cup qualifier against the Czech Republic in Valladolid on Sunday.
If they fail to take the necessary point from Atletico, the wait will be prolonged until their final fixture, away to struggling Celta Vigo the following weekend.
Real moved five points ahead of Barcelona after they beat Extremadura 5-0 on Sunday and the Catalans lost 2-1 to Hercules.

Fifth-placed Atletico will not surrender easily. Although Serbian coach Radomir Antic's side are about to surrender their title there is pride at stake after the 4-1 thrashing by Real in the league in January.
A slip-up by Real would give Barcelona a chance of snatching the crown if they can beat fourth-placed Real Betis and then Rayo Vallecano.
